page.overview:
What is Adventure Jack-O-Chica?

is an unlockable character added to FNaF World in Update 2. She can be unlocked after beating Foxy Fighters normally with a B or C rank.

Jack-O-Chica is a re-skin of Adventure Nightmare Chica to resemble her appearance in Five Nights at Freddy's 4: Halloween Edition. She carries a yellow pumpkin on the corrected hand, like her original core series character.
